[[{{PAGENAME}}]] may refer to:
# The [[Captain-General (Andor)|military rank]] of the head of the [[Queen's Guard]] in [[Andor]]. It is unclear if the rank is exclusive, since both [[Gareth Bryne]] and [[Aranvor Naldwinn]] held the title simultaneously during the [[Aiel War]].
# The title given to the [[Captain-General (Green Ajah) |head of the Green Ajah]], though known only to members of the Green.
# A [[Captain-General (Seanchan)|Seanchan rank]], the highest in the [[Ever Victorious Army]] except for [[Marshal-General]], which is a temporary rank sometimes given to a Captain-General put in charge of war.
# The highest rank in the [[Illianer Companions]].
